text:
We tested @seedance2_ai 2.0 against @Kling_ai 3.0 across a range of emotional performances using naturalistic language in the prompt to see how each model handles cinematic acting.

Across most of the tests, Seedance felt more emotionally nuanced and natural, while Kling often leaned a bit broader and more theatrical in its performances.

We broke down all the tests in our latest blog post here:
https://t.co/CW7H0U7lHs
content: Use naturalistic language in your Seedance prompt to elicit more emotionally nuanced, cinematic acting performances.
